blocks.text: MELBOURNE, Australia—Australian mushroom killer Erin Patterson failed to overturn a slew of convictions on Friday, and a judge instead, imposed a heavier prison sentence for three “cold and calculated” poisoning murders. Patterson was last year found guilty of murdering her husband’s parents and aunt in 2023, deliberately lacing their beef Wellington lunch with lethal death cap mushrooms. The strange nature of the “mushroom murders” fueled intense global interest, with Patterson’s 11-week trial drawing more publicity than almost any other Australian case in recent memory.
